problem: Endgame and Doomsday pages have very different daily scale
action: added index_day0 (launch day = 100) and min-max columns for the 14-day trailer window; chart c1 plots the index
reason: normalisation: puts films of different size on one footing; the raw view counts are kept next to it

problem: views and net collection cannot share one axis
action: z-score of each series over the same 28 days for chart c2 (correlation r is unchanged by this step)
reason: normalisation: one footing for two units, no dual axis

problem: Endgame (2019) and the Encore re-release (2026) differ about 10x in rupees, so their decay curves cannot be compared raw
action: each day as % of that film's own day-1 net (chart c5, Monday test)
reason: normalisation: compares shape of decay, not size; the rupee amounts are compared separately after the CPI step
